import CategoryTheory.Limits
import CategoryTheory.ModuleCat
import CategoryTheory.Additive
import Algebra.Module

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {R : Type u} [Ring R] : CategoryTheory.Limits.HasFiniteBiproducts (ModuleCat R) := by
  let C := ModuleCat R
  let has_zero := C.hasZeroObject
  let has_binary_products := C.hasBinaryProducts
  let has_binary_coproducts := C.hasBinaryCoproducts
  let is_additive := C.isAdditive

  have : C.hasFiniteBiproducts :=
    AddCommGrpCat.instHasFiniteBiproducts.ofAdditive C.isAdditive
      (by exact C.hasZeroObject)
      (by exact C.hasBinaryProducts)
      (by exact C.hasBinaryCoproducts)

  exact this
